question: Where and whom must the worshipper worship at the tip of the limbless flower?
premises: The ritual location is the tip of the limbless flower.
The object of worship is Tripurasundarī.
inference: Therefore the worshipper should worship Tripurasundarī at the tip of the limbless flower.
uncertainties: The exact ritual referent of anaṅgakusuma is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: But at the tip of the limbless flower, one should worship Tripurasundarī.
